title: Demo Episode Judge
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Imitation Learning for Robotics
description: Read the five rules for recording good demonstration episodes for imitation learning. Then judge eight described episodes: is each one worth keeping, or must it be recorded again? Used in Chapter 14.

educational.topic: Judging the quality of demonstration episodes
learningObjectives: Judge eight described demonstration episodes as worth keeping or needing to be re-recorded, using the data-collection guidance of the chapter, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Read the criteria and their reasons, then judge described cases against them and compare with the justification
keyQuestions: Which rule does each re-recorded episode break?
Why is planned variation in the object location good, while changing everything at once is not?
commonMisconceptions: More variety in every episode is always better
A bad episode can stay because the policy will average it out
The camera can be moved between episodes
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed verdicts, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Next episode / See score / Try again
